notes.title: New Demo Update: Controller Support + Smarter Balance
notes.notes:
🛠️ Update: Controller Support Added + Gameplay Rebalanced!
Hey adventurers!

We just pushed a fresh update to the demo — and it’s a big one, especially for those who like playing with a controller in hand.
[hr][/hr]🎮 Full Controller Support is Now Live!
You can now play the entire demo using your favorite controller (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.). Wall runs, trap dodging, ledge balancing — all fully mapped and tuned for smooth gamepad control.
[hr][/hr]⚔️ Gameplay & Enemy Rebalancing
We’ve made several balance adjustments based on your feedback:

Smarter enemy pacing and positioning

Improved difficulty curve for smoother progression

Maze and dungeon areas are still challenging, but more fair and readable

Combat encounters feel more rewarding without being overwhelming

Whether you gave up at the maze  or just wanted a more polished flow — this one’s for you.
[hr][/hr]
If you tried the demo before, now’s a great time to jump back in and feel the improvements. And if you haven’t yet, what are you waiting for? Go give it a run, wishlist the game, and let us know what you think!
